Ad rules

## What Colombia expects from sponsored posts.

01

### The SIC guide

The SIC’s 2020 guide asks influencers to label paid content as advertising, in Spanish and as visible as the main message. It is guidance, based on Colombia’s consumer statute.

[SIC guide, 2020](https://kreab.com/bogota/wp-content/uploads/sites/9/2020/10/guia-de-buenas-practicas-superintendencia.pdf)

02

### Enforcement is real

In 2023 the SIC opened investigations into companies linked to influencers, including over undisclosed commercial ties.

[Xataka Colombia, Jul 2023](https://www.xataka.com.co/legislacion-y-derechos/sic-abrio-millonaria-investigacion-cuatro-influenciadores-colombia-publicidad-enganosa-asi-han-respondido)

03

### A new law is coming

A Senate bill on content creators would require labels such as “Publicidad”. It passed its first debate in 2025 and is still pending.

[Senado de Colombia, Jul 2025](https://senado.gov.co/index.php/el-senado/noticias/6638-senado-le-apuesta-a-la-regulacion-de-la-actividad-de-los-
